      "comment": "needs-a-human: a small behavior-preserving optimization is plausible, but the performance-evidence gate must replace a functional RED requirement before implementation.

Scope: EntityGraphs.areEqual(Map, Map) in hibernate-core; semantic coverage belongs beside the existing graph EntityGraphsTest. No public API or schema change is proposed.

Two-way door: replacing first-map key iteration with entry iteration is a narrow, revertible implementation change.

Verified at 37616099b745e01500f65eb580f9cef270550cdb:
- The map overload first handles identity/nulls, then compares key sets, then performs a.get(key) and b.get(key) for each compared pair. Keeping the key-set check preserves absent-key versus present-null distinctions and avoids value traversal for mismatched keys.
- For k pairs actually compared, the current second pass contains 2k map get calls; entry iteration would contain k map get calls plus k entry getValue calls. This is static operation accounting, not a measured speedup. Expected linear map traversal remains linear; recursive graph comparison costs are separate.
- AttributeNodeImpl materializes nonempty subgraph maps as HashMaps. Map creation and recursive comparison can outweigh the saved lookups; end-to-end benefit is unmeasured.
- AbstractEntityGraphTest and EntityGraphsTest already cover reordered attributes, equal/unequal key and value subgraphs, null root graphs, and polymorphic subgraphs. Direct map-overload null-map/null-value/absent-key cases need focused coverage.
- The separate nested attribute-node algorithm is out of scope. This is the sole issue in the batch; no duplicates are closed.

Gate: use baseline-GREEN public-API semantic tests, then a separately labelled bounded performance experiment on identical fixtures before/after the minimal patch. Cover empty/singleton/multi-entry maps, equal and early/late mismatches, and representative real subgraphs; report results without imposing an unstable timing assertion. A disposable operation-count probe may corroborate the accounting, but must not become an internal-call-count regression test.

No functional defect has been established, so an honest functional RED cannot currently be supplied. If functional RED is mandatory, skip this optimization rather than fabricate one. Coordinator review must choose the performance-evidence route before any test-only or production stage.

Read-only inspection only: no source edits, compilation, tests or benchmarks were run."
